South Africa (4-2-3-1): Ronwen Williams; Kamogelo Sebelebele, Ime Okon, Olwethu Makhanya, Aubrey Modiba; Yaya Sithole, Teboho Mokoena; Thapelo Maseko, Relebohile Mofokeng, Oswin Appollis; Iqraam Rayners.

South Africa have no injuries or suspensions heading into this clash and are unlikely to make sweeping changes to the team. Ime Okon should start at the back while Teboho Mokoena is set to line up in midfield, with Iqraam Rayners leading the line once again.
